tests.description: Timed check on Peace, Justice and Reconciliation

questions.question: Explain two religious teachings about peace and reconciliation.
questions.correctAnswer: 1) Jesus taught "Blessed are the peacemakers" (Matthew 5:9) and "Love your enemies" (Matthew 5:44). Christians are called to work for peace and reconciliation, following Jesus' example of forgiving his enemies even on the cross. 2) The Qur'an teaches "If they seek peace, then seek peace" (Surah 8:61). Muhammad demonstrated this through the Treaty of Hudaybiyyah, making peace with his enemies. Isla
